outcome: SARS-CoV-2 RNA via in situ hybridization (ISH)
cohort: The study included 151 patients diagnosed with SARS-CoV-2 during pregnancy (March-October 2020) and an age-matched comparison cohort of patients from March-October 2019.
finding: Patients with clinical COVID-19 were more likely to show chronic villitis (29% vs. 8% in controls, P<0.001), and SARS-CoV-2-exposed placentas that stained positively for SARS-CoV-2 (which was rare) exhibited abnormal fibrin deposition, inflammatory changes, and decidual arteriopathy.
